$schema_notes.purpose: Question bank for StudyplanAI Mock Test module (Chapter-wise + Full-length).
$schema_notes.options_rule: Always exactly 4 options, keys A-D, single correctOption.

usage.chapter_wise_test: Filter by subject + chapterCode, randomly sample N questions (15/30/45).
usage.full_length_test: Pull 45 Physics + 45 Chemistry + 90 Biology (Botany+Zoology) at random, respecting a roughly even difficulty mix if possible.
usage.pyq_field: Optional. Use to let users filter 'Previous Year Questions only' as a future feature.
usage.explanation_field: Shown in review mode after the test (or instantly for chapter-wise if user enables instant review).

questions.questionText: A block of mass 2 kg rests on a frictionless surface. A force of 10 N is applied horizontally. What is the acceleration of the block?
questions.explanation: Using F = ma, a = F/m = 10/2 = 5 m/s².

questions.questionText: The escape velocity of a body from Earth's surface is approximately:
questions.explanation: Escape velocity v_e = √(2GM/R) ≈ 11.2 km/s for Earth.

questions.questionText: Which type of hybridization is present in the carbon atoms of ethyne (C2H2)?
questions.explanation: Each carbon in ethyne forms one sigma bond with the other carbon, one with hydrogen, and two pi bonds - sp hybridization.

questions.questionText: Which part of the nephron is primarily responsible for the reabsorption of glucose and amino acids?
questions.explanation: The PCT reabsorbs nearly all glucose and amino acids via active transport.
